about_the_game:
This artbook details the creation of KARMA: The Dark World, as well as sharing information about Pollard Studio and how the small indie team from China took art from concept sketches all the way through to a finished game.

This artbook contains :

- 138 pages

- Concept art and never before seen prototype drafts of the games characters, enemies and environments

- Notes from the developers on how they came up with the ideas for everything in the game, and their iterative design process.

- Breakdowns of the story and events that occur in the game.

- Posters and product designs as displayed in game

- Additional art pieces based on the events of the game.

content_descriptors.notes: This artbook contains content which may not be appropriate for all ages: Violence, Blood, Use of Tobacco and fantasy Drugs.
